      "type": "suggestion",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "ordering and interactions between debug, trace, and exclude arguments create unnecessary RPC interface complexity",
      "quote": "We have quite a bit of complexity wrt interface (documentation), implementation, and tests to deal with the interactions and ordering of these `debug`, `trace`, `exclude` options.",

      "status": "accepted",

      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3028736551",
      "status_by_quote": "Fair, not all breaking changes are equally breaking, and I agree we should properly weigh the impact this has on users."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4976442638",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "having three interacting options (-debug, -trace, -debugexclude) to control log levels is unnecessarily confusing when a single option should cover it",
      "quote": "approach NACK because having three options (`-debug`, `-trace`, `-debugexclude`) interact to control log levels is unnecessarily confusing when a single option should cover it.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "ryanofsky reiterated the approach NACK in response to milestone discussion",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5232630520"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5233459395"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5369066469",
      "status_by_quote": "The approach this PR takes to resolve the issue is also confusing and breaks RPC compatibilty and there is a simpler approach without these drawbacks in #35387 that should be considered and evaluated."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4976442638",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "impossible to configure trace as default while keeping specific categories at debug because -trace=all overrides per-category -debug",
      "quote": "That last point makes some reasonable configurations impossible: you can't set trace as the default log level while keeping specific categories at debug, because any per-category `-debug=<cat>` will be overridden by `-trace=all`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "ryanofsky reiterated the approach NACK in response to milestone discussion",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5232630520"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5233459395"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5369066469",
      "status_by_quote": "The approach this PR takes to resolve the issue is also confusing and breaks RPC compatibilty and there is a simpler approach without these drawbacks in #35387 that should be considered and evaluated."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:3562045342",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Both the new `BCLog::NO_RATE_LIMIT` and `-loglevel` changes make for a more natural and ergonomic interface for both developers and users, and the changes required are limited enough.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "BCLog::NO_RATE_LIMIT",
        "-loglevel"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4051146867",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "The new `-debug` and `-trace` startup options are a lot easier to use, and although I think the RPC interface is getting increasingly unwieldy, this seems to be the best approach minimizing breaking changes to expose the trace level there too.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "-debug",
        "-trace",
        "RPC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4264064556",
      "verdict": "Tested ACK",
      "reason": "tACK 5b114839c24f2298cd57c3d724f85f39400d6832",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Re-classified ryanofsky's scope request as a suggestion (fixed by splitting PRs). Split ryanofsky's approach NACK into two parts (confusing interacting flags and impossible configurations), both marked contested following his pushback during milestone review.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "decision",
      "what": "decision on approach: this PR's interacting -trace flag model versus ryanofsky's unified -loglevel proposal in #35387",
      "id": "c:5369066469"
    }
  ]
}
